name: search_clinical_trials
description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov for clinical studies. Filter by status (recruiting, completed). Returns trial IDs, phases, conditions, interventions.

parameters.query: string — search terms (e.g. 'rapamycin aging', 'APOE Alzheimer', 'metformin longevity')

returns: dict with trials list: nct_id, title, phase, status, conditions, interventions, ClinicalTrials URL
